current_grouping: Subpart D – UA Design and Construction

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UAV Design and Construction
versions.text: (a) If compliance with the ground load requirements of USAR.479 to USAR.483 is shown dynamically by drop test, one drop test must be conducted that meets USAR.725 except that the drop height must be (1) 2.25 times the drop height prescribed in USAR.725 (a); or (2) Sufficient to develop 1.5 times the limit load factor. (b) The critical landing condition for each of the design conditions specified in USAR.479 to USAR.483 must be used for proof of strength.
